---
title: "Story 7: Telling a Data Story with Shiny"
---

**Assigned:** Week 13 | **Due:** Sunday, December 13 at midnight Eastern | **Points:** 100

For this assignment, take one of your data stories and convert it into an interactive dashboard using Shiny. You should submit your shiny app as an `app.R` file, and you may choose to also deploy it for free on [shinyapps.io](https://www.shinyapps.io/).

Your app should go beyond just replicating some of the visualizations in your original data story; you should include interactive inputs that enhance the depth of insight generated from your visualizations.
